## Concepts

- [[complex-nodes]] - NodeType::COMPLEX carries a runtime type_label plus JSON attributes stored in a sidecar file.  `#complex #json`
- [[in-edges-index]] - A RAM-only reverse map from node id to the nodes pointing at it, so delete_node is O(deg_in).  `#ram #delete`
- [[freelist]] - Freed disk regions are recycled through LIFO bins segregated by exact size, so every reuse is an exact fit.  `#freelist #disk`
- [[tombstoning]] - A deleted node keeps its fixed-width nodes.idx slot so its id can be recycled, while its data regions are zeroed and freed.  `#delete #disk`

## Components

- [[type-registry]] - node_type_of<T> maps a C++ payload type to its on-disk NodeType tag.  `#types #compile-time`
- [[edge-record]] - The 48-byte Edge POD and the per-(node,relation) doubly-linked list that makes add_edge O(1).  `#disk-format #edges`
- [[relation-batch]] - NodeRelationList: a constant 2213-byte batch of up to 8 relation lines, addressable in place and chainable.  `#disk-format #relations`
- [[graph-class]] - Graph owns the in-RAM node map, the inbound index and meta, and persists on every mutation.  `#ram #orchestration`
- [[logger]] - Header-only leveled logger writing to both a log file and stderr.  `#logging`
- [[odt-layer]] - The only layer allowed to convert between RAM domain structs and on-disk PODs.  `#odt #translation`
- [[pod-layout]] - pod_struct.h: every on-disk record, packed to 1 byte and host-byte-order dependent.  `#disk-format #structs`
- [[legacy-c-prototypes]] - data_tructures/ and node_n_pointers.c are early C prototypes, not in the build.  `#legacy #dead-code`
- [[persistence-io]] - io/graph_io and io/io_utils: the read/write paths between POD records and the db/ files.  `#io #disk`
- [[traversal-policies]] - One traverse template with a swappable frontier policy; bfs and dfs are thin wrappers.  `#traversal`

## Decisions

- [[decision-o1-add-edge]] - Exploit the fixed-width batch to add an edge without rewriting the node, and overwrite a weight with an 8-byte in-place write.  `#perf #edges`
- [[decision-exact-size-freelist-bins]] - One bin file per distinct free-region size, so push and pop are O(1) and every reuse is an exact fit.  `#freelist #disk`
- [[decision-fixed-width-relation-batch]] - Freeze relations into a constant-size batch of fixed-width lines and chain edges, to make single-relation updates addressable in place.  `#disk-format #perf`
- [[decision-pod-vs-domain-split]] - Two parallel struct hierarchies - one tuned for RAM, one for disk - with an explicit translation layer between them.  `#architecture`
- [[decision-in-ram-inbound-index]] - Rebuild the reverse edge index at load instead of persisting it, trading an O(N+E) scan for schema stability.  `#ram #delete`
- [[decision-relation-batch-chaining]] - A node's relation list is a chain of fixed-width batches linked by next_offset, so nothing caps the relation types per node.  `#disk-format #relations`
- [[decision-json-sidecar-for-complex]] - Keep variable-length JSON out of nodes.dat, in per-node files under db/attributes/.  `#complex #disk`

## Procedures

- [[build-and-run]] - Configure and build with CMake plus Ninja on the MSYS2 ucrt64 toolchain, and run the binary from build/.  `#build #cmake`
- [[smoke-test]] - main.cpp is the only verification harness: seven phases covering insert, reload, delete, reuse, compaction, edge chains and relation-batch chaining.  `#test #regression`
